slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

talking to yourself kindly

for a week, when you make a mistake, say to yourself what you'd say to a friend in the same spot. the voice in your head is the one you hear most, so make it someone you'd want around.

writing your rules

write 5 rules you want to live by and read them every morning for a month. people with clear rules don't have to decide who they are every time someone pushes them.

same time training

train at the same time every day, even for just 15 minutes. a body you keep promises to becomes the quiet foundation of every other kind of confidence you build.

five minutes of wisdom

give 5 minutes a day to one idea from a great thinker: a stoic, a poet, a scientist. borrowing wisdom from people who lived through worse makes your own problems feel smaller.

five minutes of wisdom

give 5 minutes a day to one idea from a great thinker: a stoic, a poet, a scientist. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy, and your own problems start feeling smaller.

slides.texte_overlay:
saying your goal out loud

tell one person your goal for the month, out loud, with a date. saying it to someone makes it real, and following through makes you someone you can trust.
